targets.expr: 1 - sum by (node, node_name) (rate(asus_router_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (node, node_name) (rate(asus_router_cpu_seconds_total{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Radio sensors are raw driver values; some older chips report in a different scale.

panels.title: Mesh node ping from LAN
panels.description: Smokeping pings to router and mesh node IPs.

panels.title: Ping from the server (router, nodes, ISP gateway)
panels.description: Blackbox ICMP every 15 s to the targets the collector lists at `/sd/nodes`: new mesh nodes appear on their own. A node that's slow here but fine in smokeping points at the backhaul.

panels.title: Radios
panels.description: From `wl chanspec`, `wl noise` and `wl chanim_stats` on each node. DFS channels (5 GHz 52-144) must move when the radio detects radar. Busy is 100 minus the driver's idle airtime share.

panels.title: Airtime busy
panels.description: Share of time the channel was not idle: our traffic, other networks and non-Wi-Fi noise.

panels.title: Other networks on the channel
panels.description: `obss` airtime: frames from neighbouring networks on the same channel. High values mean a less crowded channel would help.

panels.title: Noise floor
panels.description: Lower (more negative) is better. A rise of 5-10 dB points at nearby interference.

panels.title: Channel
panels.description: Primary channel per radio over time; a change is a DFS move, auto channel or a manual change.

panels.title: Exposure
panels.description: Settings that open the router or LAN to the outside, read from nvram. `ssh_wan` and `webui_wan` (router admin reachable from the internet) should stay off. UPnP lets any device open ports; WPS push-button/PIN pairing is a known weak spot.

panels.title: Settings last changed
panels.description: When the collector saw the router's settings change: a hash of `nvram show` (taken on the router, values never leave it) without keys that change on their own. Empty until the first change after the collector started.

panels.title: Open ports
panels.description: Port forwarding rules (set by you in the web UI) and UPnP mappings (opened by devices on their own). Each is a way in from the internet.

panels.title: VPN clients
panels.description: Connected OpenVPN clients from the server status file. WireGuard peers only show traffic: see the chart for their last handshake.

panels.title: VPN clients connected
panels.description: WireGuard counts a peer as connected while it handshook in the last 3 minutes.

panels.title: Topology
panels.description: Main router, mesh nodes and every device attached to each, from the AiMesh client list. Scroll to zoom, drag to pan, click a node for its details.

targets.expr: topk by (id) (1, max by (id, title, subtitle) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (node, node_name, role) (asus_router_info), "id", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "node_name", "(.+)"), "subtitle", "$1", "role", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (mac, hostname, band) (asus_client_info), "subtitle", "wired", "band", ""), "subtitle", "$1", "band", "(.+)"), "id", "$1", "mac", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "mac", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "hostname", "(.+)")))

topk by (id) (1, max by (id, source, target) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (mac, node) (asus_client_info), "id", "$1", "mac", "(.*)"), "source", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "target", "$1", "mac", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max by (ip, node) (asus_mesh_node_info), "id", "$1", "ip", "(.*)"), "source", "$1", "node", "(.*)"), "target", "$1", "ip", "(.*)")))

panels.title: Port link speed
panels.description: Every node's Ethernet ports, from the main router's /tmp/diag_port_status.json (what the web UI shows). W0 is the WAN or wired-backhaul port. 100 or 10 Mbit/s on a gigabit port usually means a bad cable, a 2-pair cable or a slow device on the other end.

panels.title: Link speed over time
panels.description: Ports with a link. A step down is a link that renegotiated slower (see the alert "Ethernet port linked slower than before").

panels.title: Events in range
panels.description: Counted from /tmp/syslog.log on each node, from lines written after the collector started. ssh_login_key includes the collector's own logins.

panels.title: Logins and failures per hour
panels.description: ssh_login_password: something logged in to the router with the admin password (the Asus app, a script, or a person). Failures are worth a look.

panels.title: Wi-Fi and WAN events per hour
panels.description: roam_assist / weak_signal_kick: the router pushed a device off a weak link. dfs_radar: radar forced a 5 GHz channel change.

panels.title: SSH command time (p95)
panels.description: How long each router command takes over SSH.

panels.title: Collector problems
panels.description: Per hour. One connect per node is normal; more means the connection keeps dropping.
